about: Wheel events recorded in Chrome 126 on a MacBook Air M3 (macOS, natural scrolling on): a Logitech M590 notched wheel and the built-in trackpad. On 12/11/2026 only the first 40 events of each trackpad gesture were kept; on 13/11 every event, at page zoom 100 % and 110 %. Deltas rounded to 3 decimals.
